desc: Derive and prove the scheduling formula: min operations = `max(max_count, ceil(sum_counts/2))`, with zeros usable as padding partners.

Implement the complete solution: `hits(x)` via `(x.bit_length()+1)//2` for x>=1, `prefix_hits(n)` by iterating base-4 blocks, and per-query answer `max(hits(r), (prefix_hits(r)-prefix_hits(l-1)+1)//2)` accumulated over all queries.
Validate against examples and edge cases (`[1,3]`, power-of-4 boundaries, `r=1e9`, brute-force cross-check on small ranges), then finalize complexity `O(q log r)` time, `O(1)` extra space.
